name: Úvaly (Czechia)
description: A red vertical stripe at the hoist one quarter of the flag's length, and three horizontal stripes of blue, white and blue in the ratio 1:2:1 in the fly.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 11 May 2006 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
